Diamond Price Per Carat

You can find the diamond price per carat on this site, and use the calculators to value your diamond and jewelry. To get started, you can use the diamond value calculator to determine the price of your diamond based on its characteristics.

How it Works for Valuing Diamonds

To value a diamond, you can use the diamond value calculator, which takes into account the diamond's carat weight, cut, color, and clarity. You can also use the GIA report value calculator to determine the value of a diamond with a GIA report. Additionally, you can compare diamonds using the compare diamonds tool.

What You Get and What it Costs

The diamond and jewelry calculators are free to use, with no account or payment required. You can also access 250+ reference pages, 37 ring sizes in 5 systems, and information on 21 gem types. For jewelers, the Widget Pro is available for $12/month per domain.

FAQ

What is the resale value of a diamond? The resale value of a natural diamond is roughly 25-40% of retail, while lab-grown diamonds are roughly 5-12%. Can I use the calculators for free? Yes, the diamond and jewelry calculators are free to use, with no account or payment required. How many ring sizes are available? There are 37 ring sizes available in 5 systems.

Calculate the value of your diamond now
